name: ecommerce-shipping
description: What a shipment costs and how long it is expected to take.
features: Destination zones with explicit precedence and write-time overlap refusal
Flat and table rates whose bands must tile their axis
Free shipping above an order subtotal, as a rate rule
Restrictions that exclude a service level with a recorded reason
Carrier rating seam with three distinguishable outcomes
Derived and quoted prices told apart by a stored discriminator
Integer transit-day delivery estimates with an explicit basis
Surcharges recorded as separate adjustment lines
